path.data-description: the recess the C14 sits in. The connector is std/c14-inlet@1, composed.

rect.data-description: the wattage label on the handle's left, printed downwards

path.data-description: The translucent handle, lit from within. ISM table 136: green - a valid source is connected and the supply is operational; blinking amber - a problem with the supply; not illuminated - no power connected; blinking green - firmware is being updated; five green blinks at 4 Hz then off - a mismatch with the other supply.

rect.data-description: the orange release latch, pressed to withdraw the supply
